reasons: The registered neutral expression and X-mouth patches replace rather than preserve the authored GS070 neutral face.
Several visemes produce an over-wide oral cavity and abrupt teeth or lip scale changes that read as atlas swaps instead of speech.
The independently pasted mouth and upper-face RGB crops overlap and do not provide explicit semantic ownership in their shared cheek band.
Sharp decoded pixels and correct timing do not compensate for the identity and acting discontinuity.
required_repairs: Use the authored plate as the exact neutral and X state.
Apply atlas states as bounded deltas from registered neutral patches.
Resolve expression and mouth overlap once through declared feature ownership.
Preview the complete acting beat from unencoded pixels before allowing a new versioned encode.
